nom: Bubble Plus One Tinted Daily Mineral Sunscreen Broad Spectrum SPF 40

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers are split: several say it stays matte/satin and doesn't get greasy, while others report visible shine, oil peeking through, or a shiny/greasy finish.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers generally find it hydrating and non-greasy, though a few say it is drying around the eyes, nose and ears or too heavy under makeup, and one advises pairing it with a separate moisturizer.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe it as working well and moisturizing without excess product, though one notes it can turn greasy if left on too long.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers (including rosacea) mostly report no irritation, no eye sting and no breakouts, but one with semi-sensitive skin describes a burning sensation when sweating or in heat/sun.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers report it calms and smooths the skin and wears well under makeup, with no negative reports in this segment.
segments.normal: Normal/dry-leaning reviewers found the tint too dark or the finish tacky and slow to set under foundation.

concerns.aging: Reviewers with mature or aging skin report the product calms and smooths skin, wears well under makeup, and one says it deflects attention from fine lines rather than settling into them; no negative aging-related reports.
concerns.dehydration: Most describe it as hydrating and non-drying, but a few report it feels heavy or causes noticeable dryness around the eyes, nose and ears.
concerns.redness: One rosacea sufferer reports it doesn't irritate or trigger breakouts and has become her go-to; another describes an uncomfortable burning sensation when sweating or in heat/sun despite not being a true allergic reaction.
concerns.barrier: No reviewers specifically discuss barrier impairment or repair with this product.
concerns.spots: One reviewer relies on it to prevent melasma but finds it feels heavy and sweats off the exact spot she needs coverage on, reducing its usefulness for hyperpigmentation.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and consider it a holy grail for acne-prone skin, but two describe breaking out with oiliness or cystic bumps after wearing it, especially with sweating.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers say it keeps oily skin matte or satin without added grease, while others describe it as oily, shiny, or requiring setting powder to control shine.

aspects.libelle: Orange or dark cast on fair skin
No white cast on deeper skin tones
Heavy or tacky feel under makeup

extraits.titre: There is no way this is for acne skin
extraits.texte: Despite the description, I found this incredibly oily after application. I have to admit it looked nice. I found myself breaking out with cystic bumps within days of wearing it, especially if I ended up sweating, giving away the tube before I even finish it.

I have very sesitive, acne prone skin and this sunscreen has checked every box for me! I was nervous to add a new product to my routine, but im SO happy i did. I almost never write reviews, but this sunscreen deserves five stars. The tint can be blended into even the fairest of skin (hi, redhead here). I thought it would be too dark, but i just make sure to blend it doen my neck and at my hairline. It gives a nice bronzey glow but doesnt look orange/too dark. No new breakouts which is the biggest win!

extraits.titre: Good formula but a deep tint
extraits.texte: The tint is way too dark and does not work for all skin tones. I have blond hair and fair skin, and it stains my hair line and does not blend in evenly. I can't wear it on its own, but my foundation layers on it beautifully. It doesn't get oily and hasn't broken me out- and I have oily and acne prone skin. I chose this sunscreen because the ingredients were the best I could find that was still pregnancy safe! It does not come off easily with a regular face wash and I have to use micellar water. Overall, I would not buy again unless they come out with an untinted version.

With my type 2 Rosacea it's very hard to find a sunscreen that doesn't irritate my skin or cause breakouts. This sunscreen I have boughten multiple times and will continue to buy. The tint gives you a nice glow and blends very well, even on my pale winter skin. Everytime I switch to a different one, it doesn't work out so I have found my go-to sunscreen.

I wanted to love it and I do love some things about it! It goes on so smoothly and has a light non greasy feel, and doesn't leave any visible cast. Unfortunately, one of the main reasons I use spf is to prevent melasma (skin darkening) on my upper lip. This product immediately feels so heavy only on that spot and makes my pores start to sweat! I end up sweating it off one of the most important parts of my face immediately. I also noticed that when it's really hot and and mixes with my sweat, it makes the sensitive skin under my eyes burn a little. So I'd say, for me it will work for winter when I'm not sweating a lot, but is not ideal for lots of sun and sweat.

Jen Phelps recommended this on a survey she did on mineral sunscreens! This sunscreen does great with makeup application or wear by itself'. No white cast! Doesn't break me out or cause any allergic reaction! Jen was spot on with her evaluation! Plus it's so affordable! If you go in the water you will need a water resistant sunscreen for protection from UVA/UVB rays! Hope this help! I have mature skin and this is my favorite after Using sun protection my entire adult life!
i love the way this applies and it doesnt burn my eyes like other sunscreens but it makes my face so incredibly dry around my eyes and nose and behind my ears and its so uncomfortable
